start.name_zh: DAT4#阀室（重庆市潼南区，大英-安岳-铜梁支干线，EIA原文OCR误作'漳南区'）
start.name_en: Valve Chamber DAT4#, Tongnan District (on the Daying-Anyue-Tongliang branch trunk)
start.geocode_source: EIA (Phase 2 doc) states 'DAT4#阀室 | 重庆市潼南区 | 97.2 | 20.0' (mileage 97.2km on the 大英-安岳-铜梁支干线, a separate major Phase 2 branch trunk from Sichuan into Tongliang). This matches GEM's 'Valve Chamber No. 4' (a differently-prefixed 'DAT'-series numbering specific to that branch, distinct from the plain '4#阀室' on the main Neijiang-Tongliang trunk, which is in Anyue County, Sichuan and does not match). No exact GPS given for DAT4# itself; coordinate is the nearest sourced township's groundwater well ('香炉村4组', unlabeled well ID) at 105.809E/29.857N in 卧佛镇 (Wofo Town), 潼南区 -- the first/westernmost of three townships (卧佛镇, 五桂镇, 寿桥镇) with sourced coordinates along this branch within Tongnan District; DAT4# sits ~24km upstream (west) of the branch's Tongliang compressor-station terminus, consistent with a position nearer 卧佛镇 than the other two townships, but this is inferential, not a confirmed 1:1 match.

end.name_zh: 潼南区（潼南供气支线/潼南供气管道，梓潼街道，区政府驻地）
end.name_en: Tongnan District (Tongnan local gas-supply branch), Zitong Subdistrict, the district seat
end.geocode_source: Nominatim query '梓潼街道,潼南区,重庆市' -> OSM relation 20731743 (subdistrict admin boundary), the district seat/main urban area of Tongnan District. Matches GEM's generic EndLocation='Tongnan'; chosen deliberately distinct from the DAT4# start proxy (~36km apart) to avoid a degenerate near-zero-length line, since both the branch tap and the district destination are nominally 'Tongnan'.

corridor_notes: Short local gas-supply branch (供气支线) tapping the 大英-安岳-铜梁支干线 (a separate Phase 2 storage/interconnect branch, itself running from Daying/Anyue in Sichuan through Tongnan District to a Tongliang compressor station) at DAT4#阀室 within Tongnan District, then running further into Tongnan District (toward the district seat, Zitong Subdistrict) to serve local gas demand. The Phase 2 EIA explicitly lists '潼南供气管道' [OCR '漳南'] among the 8 Phase 3 supply branches (combined 135.6km). See P7568 for the Phase 2/Phase 3 labeling note.
researcher_notes: GEM's 'Valve Chamber No. 4' initially cross-matched to the wrong feature: a plain '4#阀室' exists on the main Neijiang-Tongliang trunk in Anyue County, Sichuan (Phase 1 scope), which does not fit this branch's Tongnan/Chongqing location. Careful cross-referencing found the correct match on the separate DAT-prefixed numbering used for the 大英-安岳-铜梁支干线 in the Phase 2 doc, located in 潼南区 as expected. The exact town for DAT4# (among 卧佛镇/五桂镇/寿桥镇) is not confirmed -- 卧佛镇 was chosen as the nearest plausible candidate by relative position along the branch, and this should be treated as an approximation, not a confirmed valve-chamber location.
blockers: DAT4#'s precise township (vs. district-level 潼南区) is inferred, not directly sourced; treat start coordinate as approximate.
